rows.note: Use 結餘 as the usual noun for the balance remaining in a bank or other account.

example.english: How much balance is left in your bank account?
example.traditional: 你個銀行戶口仲有幾多結餘？
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2 zung6 jau5 gei2 do1 git3 jyu4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is in equilibrium or keeps things even.

example.english: The weight on both sides of this table isn't even; we need to balance it.
example.traditional: 呢張枱兩邊重量唔平均，要平衡返先得。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 loeng5 bin1 zung6 loeng6 m4 ping4 gwan1 jiu3 ping4 hang4 faan1 sin1 dak1

rows.note: Use this when placing or keeping an object on a narrow or unstable support, with the context supplying the idea of balancing.

example.english: Help me balance the book on the mouth of the jar so it doesn't fall.
example.traditional: 你幫我擺住本書喺樽口，唔好畀佢跌落嚟。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 baai2 zyu6 bun2 syu1 hai2 zeon1 hau2 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dit3 lok6 lei4

rows.note: Use 平衡 as the all-purpose noun for physical equilibrium and, in contexts such as 心理平衡, mental equilibrium.

example.english: You need to keep your balance while standing on the footbridge.
example.traditional: 企喺獨木橋上要保持平衡。
example.jyutping: kei5 hai2 duk6 muk6 kiu4 soeng6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 ping4 hang4

rows.note: Use 剩低嘅部分 for the part or amount that remains, especially when referring to an agreement, task, or collection rather than an account.

example.english: The balance of the work can be done tomorrow.
example.traditional: 剩低嘅部分聽日先做都得。
example.jyutping: sing6 dai1 ge3 bou6 fan6 ting1 jat6 sin1 zou6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this for reconciling accounts so that the credits and debits match.

example.english: We have to balance the accounts every day after work.
example.traditional: 我哋每日收工都要對數。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 mui5 jat6 sau1 gung1 dou1 jiu3 deoi3 sou3

rows.note: Use 大勢 when balance means the overall trend or which side ultimately has the stronger influence, as in the balance of power.

example.english: The balance of power has now shifted to our side.
example.traditional: 而家大勢已經倒向我哋呢邊。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 daai6 sai3 ji5 ging1 dou2 hoeng3 ngo5 dei6 ni1 bin1

rows.note: Use 校 when adjusting a scale or similar setup until it is correctly balanced.

example.english: The scale is inaccurate; I need to balance it until both sides weigh the same.
example.traditional: 部磅唔準，我要校到兩邊一樣重先得。
example.jyutping: bou6 bong6 m4 zeon2 ngo5 jiu3 gaau3 dou3 loeng5 bin1 jat1 joeng6 zung6 sin1 dak1
